duration.note: slow exceeds the 200ms interactive cap by design — reserved for page-level and large-content transitions only, never buttons/inputs/hover/focus

easing.note: standard is functionally ease-in-out (the default). All four keep their Y control points within 0-1, so none overshoot — that's what 'no bounce/spring' means in bezier terms

loadingLoops.note: continuous ambient loops, not bound by the 200ms interactive cap. Spinner uses linear (constant angular velocity) rather than eased, on purpose
